slots.name: Squire's Cut
slots.description: Fast one-handed slash off the shoulder

slots.name: Rising Cut
slots.description: One-handed rising cut from his left hip up across his front

slots.name: The BONK
slots.description: Two-handed overhead smash, a kill read

slots.name: Pot-Lid Throw
slots.description: Skim the pot lid off his shoulder like a frisbee. It hits on the way out and on the way back, pulling fighters toward him, and he catches it. One lid: no second throw while it is out.

slots.name: Leap of Faith
slots.description: Rise, hang above a tracked light, then commit to a straight drop. A landed hit recovers quickly. A miss leaves the plank stuck.

slots.name: The Joust
slots.description: Rear, track the chosen fighter, scoop them onto the lance and carry. Press again to fling. Shields block the scoop. A ground carry stops at the ledge.

slots.name: Blade Storm
slots.description: Repeated hilt-to-tip greatsword slashes ending in a heavy finisher.
